name: Primal Elixir Hydration
description:
How to use it?

Add 1 scoop to 8 ounces of water. Shake and Enjoy.
Side Note: If you want a less sweet drink add more water to your liking.
We also recommend using a coffee frother stick, if you do not have a shaker. This works well to make
sure it is well blended and the best consistency.


When to take it?

Adding it to your water while you are working at your desk, running around chasing kids, during a
workout, before a run or after a hard yoga session. The Elixir is just an added plus to your water,
improving your hydration. You can also have it multiple times a day!


What is it?

The elixir will help restore your electrolytes which is crucial for maintaining fluid balance, nerve
function and muscle contractions. It helps your body retain fluids more effectively, preventing
dehydration. Our elixir specifically helps you recover faster with its added bonus of glutamine in it.
short_description:
Hydrate better, recover faster, and enjoy every sip. Primal Elixir is your daily hydration boost — a clean, refreshing mix of electrolytes, L-Glutamine, sodium, and potassium designed to support muscle function, recovery, and all-day performance. Each flavor delivers a smooth, easy-to-mix experience with no sugar, no carbs, and no artificial junk — just clean hydration you can count on.

Whether you’re training, working, exploring the outdoors, or just need a flavorful hydration pick-me-up, Primal Elixir keeps you refreshed and ready with a lineup of bold, refreshing flavors:

Lemonade • Black Currant • Tangerine • Wild Cherry • Coconut Lime Mojito

  • Clean, delicious hydration in every scoop.
  • Essential electrolytes to support performance and recovery.
  • L-Glutamine to help support muscle hydration.
  • Smooth, fast-dissolving formula for easy mixing.
  • Zero sugar, zero carbs, and naturally flavored.

Pick your flavor and stay hydrated the clean way.
